issue.title: Bug: Sync page does not show recordings.upload_error for failed takes
issue.body:
## Summary

Failed uploads show generic Sync chrome (“N uploads failed…”) and the red cloud + up-arrow (`online_failed`), but the Sync page never displays `recordings.upload_error` even though the worker persists it via `markRecordingFailed`.

That blocks diagnosing real upload failures (API 503 storage unavailable, 404 masked assignment/auth, missing `projectUnitId`, terminal client errors, etc.) without Metro/logcat.

Confirmed while investigating Chad’s report: new recording → red up-arrow cloud on build `749d31f`.

## Current vs expected

**Current**
- `markRecordingFailed(id, message)` writes `sync_status = 'failed'` + `upload_error`.
- Sync UI uses `getFailedUploadCount()` + `formatSyncStatusLabel('online_failed', { failedCount })` only.
- No screen/query surfaces `upload_error` text.

**Expected**
- Sync page (and ideally take / chapter row) shows the last failure reason for failed selected takes.
- Retry via Sync Now clears or refreshes the message after a new attempt.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Sync page shows the stored `upload_error` (or a safe summary) when `hasFailedUploads`.
- [ ] Optional but preferred: take/chapter chrome that already shows the red failed glyph also exposes the reason (a11y label or secondary text).
- [ ] After a successful retry, failed count / error copy clear appropriately.
- [ ] Unit / component tests for the failed-upload error path.

## Out of scope

- Fixing Sync Now silent no-op / pending mismatches (separate ticket).
- Changing fluent-api auth masking or R2 provisioning.

## Related

- Code: `src/db/repository.ts` (`markRecordingFailed`), `src/db/schema.ts` (`upload_error`), `src/app/screens/SyncScreen.tsx`, `src/utils/syncStatusState.ts`, `src/services/recordingSync.ts`, `src/services/verseAudioContract.ts` (503 → terminal failed).
- fluent-api `main`: `PUT /verse-audio/...` returns 503 `"Audio storage is unavailable"` when R2 is unset/unreachable.
